domains.title: GEO and AI Search
domains.purpose: Evaluate AI-search discoverability, technical eligibility, useful grounded answers, entity credibility and truthful structured data; distinguish local readiness from observed engine citations.
families: crawl indexing and snippet eligibility
search versus training access controls
intent-specific answerability and extraction
entity identity credibility freshness and source evidence
structured-data truth and locale consistency
observed citations and first-party measurement boundaries
site sampling and comparable trends
prioritized improvements without deceptive optimization
domains.safety: Read-only bounded public or authorized inspection. No private exposure, indexing submission, account/CDN changes, training opt-in, search-UI bypass, paid service or private-content upload without authorization. No guaranteed visibility or invented metrics.

domains.title: Agent Readiness
domains.purpose: Evaluate how agents discover, understand and safely operate a website, API or tool interface through consumer-first tasks, semantics, contracts and recovery; not a model evaluation or SEO certification.
families: consumer-specific discovery and content comprehension
semantic names roles labels and entity disambiguation
structured data and visible-content agreement
API and tool contract discoverability and correctness
multi-step task execution and independent outcome verification
state identity timing and recovery
human intervention and safe consequential actions
applicable standards versus optional experimental enhancements
domains.safety: Use isolated local contexts and synthetic data. Preserve authentication and approval boundaries; no CAPTCHA bypass, cloud upload, browser flag changes, installs, or consequential tool calls without authorization. Agent friendliness does not require public access.

domains.title: Accessibility and WCAG
domains.purpose: Find barriers to disabled users and produce criterion-level WCAG 2.2 evidence without treating automation alone as conformance proof.

virtualScreenReader.purpose: Use locally available Guidepup for explicit reading-order, name, state and hidden-content expectations across distinct page states. No automatic dependency installation or CDN imports.
virtualScreenReader.boundary: Simulated DOM evidence only; not real screen-reader behavior, live-announcement timing, or WCAG conformance.

families: perceivable text media structure and contrast
operable keyboard focus target size motion and timing
understandable language labels instructions errors and consistency
robust name role value status and assistive-technology semantics
zoom reflow orientation and responsive access
complete processes and materially different page states
manual checks that automation cannot decide

wcag.conformanceBoundary: Do not claim page, process, or site conformance unless all applicable criteria and complete-process requirements were evaluated with adequate evidence. Automated scans alone cannot establish conformance.

acr.publicationBoundary: Generate a working ACR from observed evidence, keep missing metadata and unresolved criteria explicit, require complete-scope and product-owner review, and never claim certification or publish automatically.

domains.reportName: Accessibility, WCAG, and ACR report set

domains.title: Security
domains.purpose: Test product, web, and API trust boundaries with safe, authorized probes and source-aware threat hypotheses.
families: authentication authorization and tenant isolation
session cookie token and logout safety
injection and output encoding
secrets and sensitive-data exposure
transport CORS CSP and security headers
dependency and supply-chain risk
rate limits abuse resistance and resource bounds
audit logging monitoring containment and recovery
domains.safety: Default to non-destructive review and benign probes. Hostile, privilege, denial-of-service, data-exfiltration, or production-impacting tests require explicit authorization, scope, limits, safe identities, and recovery.

domains.title: Load Testing
domains.purpose: Deeply inspect code and server/deployment configuration read-only for likely load failures; assess readiness, capture approved journeys and run staged replay only within explicitly approved limits. Static hypotheses are not measured capacity.
families: deep read-only code path and effective versus checked-in configuration review
source-backed bottleneck hypotheses counterevidence and conditional resource budgets
target ownership environment dependencies readiness and observation
separate capture and load-generation confirmation
sensitive traffic sanitation and replay eligibility
correlated virtual-user identities sessions and synthetic data
bounded smoke ramp pacing concurrency and request ceilings
business assertions latency throughput errors and saturation
abort recovery cleanup and non-destructive boundaries
measured stage comparisons generator limitations and reproducible retests
domains.safety: No target traffic before capture confirmation and no load before separate explicit plan-specific user approval. Enforce approved origin/routes, VUs, RPS, requests, time and stop thresholds. No third-party, production-impacting, paid, destructive or notification traffic without specific authorization. Never bypass throttling or auto-restart after abort.

domains.title: Stress Readiness and Recovery
domains.purpose: Review source/server configuration read-only and test explicit stress hypotheses using bounded isolated local loops or separately approved external scenarios, measuring correctness and recovery as well as pressure.
families: deep read-only capacity and configuration hypotheses
verified localhost isolation and remote dependency classification
two distinct sequential confirmations for any non-local stress
bounded tight-loop parsing cache cleanup queue contention and cancellation probes
independent iteration concurrency input and resource dimensions
supervision resource ceilings abort and no-egress local isolation
correctness invariants post-pressure recovery and retained state
source versus measured evidence and bounded-capacity conclusions
domains.safety: Assessment never executes app code or changes original source/server settings. Local execution needs explicit bounded approval and enforced isolation. Anything other than verified isolated localhost requires two separate sequential user confirmations. No unbounded loops, host exhaustion, detached generators, protection bypass or automatic restart after abort.

domains.title: State Integrity and Round Trips
domains.purpose: Find inconsistent, lost, stale or invalid state through source inspection and bounded multi-step, multi-tab, independent-user/API and export/reimport scenarios, including invalid-load and recovery behavior.
families: authoritative state ownership invariants transitions and persistence boundaries
multi-tab shared-session and independent-user API interleavings

isolated corruption tests source hypotheses versus demonstrated failures
minimal event-sequence reproduction and state-difference evidence
domains.safety: Source assessment is read-only. Use isolated copies and synthetic records for corruption, imports, deletion, interruption or migration. Never overwrite original exports or clear real browser/database state. Gate consequential/shared mutations; bounded actors are not load/stress authorization.
